world.title: ‘Made a scapegoat’: Wife of Indian captain jailed in UK over Russian oil vessel case
world.summary: The wife of Indian merchant navy captain Ajay Pant, arrested in the UK for alleged sanctions violations related to a Russian oil tanker, described him as a “scapegoat.” Pant, 38, has been in custody since June. His arrest is part of a broader investigation into sanctions breaches involving a shadow fleet of Russian vessels.

world.title: 'Should end war now': Iran prez claims world 'acknowledges' Tehran's victory over US
world.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has urged for an end to the conflict with the United States, asserting that Tehran should conclude the war while it still holds a favorable position. He dismissed criticisms suggesting that Iran was compelled to make concessions. Pezeshkian emphasized that the world recognizes Iran's achievements in the ongoing conflict, framing it as a victory for Tehran.

world.title: West Asia LIVE: China says U.S. 'sanctions and pressure' on Iran not a solution
world.summary: China has stated that U.S. sanctions and pressure on Iran are not effective solutions. As the U.S. implements its strictest sanctions yet and seeks support from China and allies, Iranian crude offers to Chinese buyers have decreased, leading to a rise in prices. The U.S. blockade has significantly impacted Tehran’s shipments amid ongoing threats of additional sanctions.

business.title: Updated KTM 390 Adventure Reach Showrooms - Gets New Graphics
business.summary: The updated KTM 390 Adventure has started arriving in showrooms, featuring new and revised graphics. The latest color introduced is Ebony Black, which became available prior to its official launch and website listing. KTM India is enhancing the aesthetics of the 390 Adventure, which is part of their 350cc lineup, with these new visual updates.

business.title: Three Indian smartphone brands could emerge in 10-14 months under new mobile manufacturing scheme: Vaishnaw
business.summary: India's IT and Electronics Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced that three potential players have been identified to establish competitive Indian smartphone brands within 10 to 14 months. While he did not disclose the names of these companies due to market sensitivities, the initiative is part of the government's new mobile manufacturing scheme aimed at boosting domestic production.

business.title: India reports 29 FDI investments worth Rs 4,895.65 crore under revised land-border rules
business.summary: India has announced 29 foreign direct investment transactions totaling Rs 4,895.65 crore, facilitated by revised land-border rules. These regulations permit foreign investors from bordering countries to hold up to 10% non-controlling beneficial ownership through the automatic route, subject to specific conditions. This move aims to enhance foreign investment while maintaining regulatory oversight in sensitive sectors.

technology.title: Galaxy Z Flip and Fold 8 storage upgrades are cheaper in the UK for a limited time
technology.summary: Samsung has reduced prices for the Galaxy Z Flip 8 and Fold 8/Ultra's larger storage options in the UK. Customers can save £85 on the 512GB models, while the 1TB variants also see discounts. These price cuts are available for a limited time and can be combined with trade-in savings, encouraging buyers to opt for higher storage capacities.

technology.title: I stopped caring about camera hardware years ago; the Pixel 11 Pro changed that
technology.summary: The Google Pixel 11 Pro has reignited interest in camera hardware, despite the usual pre-launch leaks that often diminish excitement. While many anticipated the flagship features and specifications, the device offers notable camera upgrades that could enhance user experience. This shift highlights the ongoing relevance of camera technology in smartphones, even as expectations evolve with each new release.

technology.title: Apple Music will label songs created using AI from the end of 2026
technology.summary: Apple Music plans to label songs created with artificial intelligence by the end of 2026. The platform will display a "Made With AI" label next to tracks, indicating the use of generative AI in their creation. Record labels will provide the necessary information regarding the AI involvement in these songs, enhancing transparency for listeners.

sports.title: Joe Root creates history in Headingly against Pakistan, moves past Steve Smith in Test cricket
sports.summary: Joe Root has made history in Test cricket by surpassing Australia’s Steve Smith to become the leading fielder for most catches. This achievement occurred during a match against Pakistan at Headingley. Root's milestone highlights his significant contribution to the sport, as he continues to excel in his career and solidify his legacy in cricket history.

sports.title: Here we go: Barcelona reach €4 million agreement for veteran goalkeeper, who will arrive in 2027
sports.summary: FC Barcelona has reached a €4 million agreement with Fenerbahçe for goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic. The 31-year-old player is expected to join Barcelona in 2027, with the deal now in its final stages. The club will soon begin the necessary paperwork to finalize the signing. This information was reported by SPORT and confirmed by Fabrizio Romano.

sports.title: Najmul Hossain tasked with keeping Bangladesh's emotions in check
sports.summary: Bangladesh's captain, Najmul Hossain, faces the challenge of managing his team's emotions following their historic win in Darwin. The victory has boosted the players' confidence, but Hossain emphasizes the importance of maintaining composure as they prepare for the second Test against Australia. His leadership will be crucial in navigating the heightened expectations and pressure during the upcoming match.

health.title: 2,500 dead and rising -- UN says DR Congo Ebola outbreak 'growing exponentially'
health.summary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is escalating rapidly, with over 2,500 deaths reported, half occurring in the last 20 days, according to the senior UN coordinator. The situation has prompted urgent attention as the disease spreads exponentially, raising concerns about public health and the need for effective intervention measures to control the outbreak.

health.title: This Week in Science: Highest Radiation Occupation, a Shooting Star, And More!
health.summary: This week in science highlights include a study identifying the occupation with the highest risk of radiation-related cancer deaths, which may surprise many. Additionally, researchers reported on jellyfish attacks and the development of lab-grown mini-brains that can sense time. These findings contribute to ongoing discussions about occupational hazards and advancements in neuroscience, showcasing the diverse nature of current scientific research.

health.title: The Protein Boom: How High-Protein Foods Are Changing the Supermarket
health.summary: High-protein foods are transforming the global supermarket landscape, expanding beyond their traditional association with athletes and bodybuilders. This trend is evident across various grocery categories, including yogurt, meat, and snacks. Supermarkets are increasingly stocking high-protein options to meet consumer demand, reflecting a shift in dietary preferences towards protein-rich diets. This change is influencing product development and marketing strategies.

science.title: How 11-year-old Atharv’s love for space led him to 3 possible asteroid detections
science.summary: Eleven-year-old Atharv Sood from Satya School has achieved recognition for three preliminary asteroid detections in the All-India Asteroid Search Campaign 2026. His journey began with a fascination for space, evolving into hands-on scientific work through school-led training. Atharv's accomplishments highlight the impact of educational programs in nurturing young scientists and fostering curiosity about the universe.

science.title: Microbes from Earth may be able to survive the Moon's South Pole
science.summary: A recent study suggests that Earth microbes could survive in the Moon's South Pole's permanently shadowed regions, which may offer temporary protection from harsh lunar conditions. The Moon's surface is typically inhospitable due to extreme temperatures, ultraviolet radiation, and cosmic rays, making survival difficult for most organisms. This research highlights the potential resilience of certain microbes in extreme environments.

science.title: How AI can take on time-consuming data work
science.summary: Hospitals treating cancer patients must convert extensive patient records into standardized registry information for reporting and research. This task is challenging due to a limited specialized workforce and the increasing volume and complexity of cancer data. Brent Dover, CEO of Carta Healthcare, advocates for the use of artificial intelligence to streamline this time-consuming data work effectively.

entertainment.title: Sowcar Janaki, the versatile face of Tamil cinema known for majestic roles and finesses
entertainment.summary: Sowcar Janaki, a legendary Tamil actress renowned for her versatility, has passed away, leaving behind a significant legacy in Indian cinema. She was one of the oldest surviving South Indian actors, celebrated for her performances in Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada films. The name 'Sowcar' became associated with her after her debut in the film Shavukaru.

entertainment.title: Can Sonia Gandhi throw Parliament's law in dustbin? Smriti Irani on Vande Mataram
entertainment.summary: BJP general secretary Smriti Irani criticized the Congress regarding the Vande Mataram controversy, questioning its choice to recognize only the first two stanzas. She referenced Rajendra Prasad's 1950 statement on the song's equal status and challenged Sonia Gandhi's position, accusing the Congress of neglecting national and Hindu sentiments in their approach to the national song.

entertainment.title: Kareena Kapoor's latest gym video sparks pregnancy buzz, internet reacts
entertainment.summary: A viral video of actor Kareena Kapoor leaving the gym has ignited speculation about a possible pregnancy. Social media users are discussing whether she might be expecting her third child, as some believe she appears to have a baby bump in the footage. The clip has generated significant online reactions, fueling ongoing discussions regarding her personal life.
